output.headline: Health IT draws strategics and sponsors at a higher multiple that sponsors can pay, while dental draws mostly high-conviction buyers at a lower multiple that sponsors cannot.
sentences: Only two buyers sit on both lists, Blackstone and TPG Capital, so the two universes barely overlap and each target needs its own outreach. [Q:shared]
Blackstone is High on both targets, while TPG Capital is Medium for Health IT but High for Dental, because its median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV. [Q:shared, Q:target_a]

Health IT's own buyers include Evolent Health as High-conviction strategic and Francisco Partners as sponsor at Medium; Dental's include Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental (ADMI) as High-conviction strategics, plus High-conviction sponsors Hellman & Friedman, General Atlantic and Welsh Carson. [Q:only_a, Q:only_b]
Health IT's defensible multiple is 21.4x and sponsors clear their 20% target return at the ask; Dental's is 15.4x and sponsors do not clear 20%. [Q:target_a, Q:target_b]
